summary: UI Redesign Testing - All cards verified with solid blue backgrounds and white text. DiaGyn doctor cards, clinic cards, time slot cards, calendar card, selected date card, and Doctor Portal stats cards all display correctly with blue (bg-blue-500/600/700) backgrounds and white text. Background UI remains white as expected.
context_for_next_testing_agent: UI redesign task completed. All cards in DiaGyn and Doctor Portal now have solid blue backgrounds with white text. The following components were verified: DoctorProfileCard (bg-blue-500/600), ClinicCard (bg-blue-500/600), TimeSlotPicker slot buttons (bg-blue-500/700), RichCalendar header (bg-blue-500), Selected Date card (bg-blue-500), Find Earliest Slot button (blue), Doctor Portal stats cards (bg-blue-500/600/700), No appointments card (bg-blue-500), and PatientCard (bg-blue-500).
